prompts.text: What do you need more of from me right now?
What's something you're afraid to want?
When do you feel most loved?
What did your family teach you about love, good and bad?
What's a dream you've quietly given up on?
How do you want us to handle hard times?
What does home mean to you?

What are you most grateful for, honestly?
